news.headline: Injury round-up: Martínez, De Ligt, Šeško, Ugarte and Darlow
news.summary: Lisandro Martínez picked up a thigh/muscle strain in the World Cup final but it isn't considered serious, with a return targeted for the Premier League opener after rest. Matthijs de Ligt remains out until autumn following back surgery, while Benjamin Šeško (shin) is on track and could feature in a later friendly. Manuel Ugarte faces a long-term absence with a suspected ACL injury from the World Cup, and Karl Darlow is recovering from a minor procedure.

news.headline: Confirmed: remaining pre-season fixtures and Premier League opener
news.summary: United's pre-season continues with Atlético Madrid (1 August, Stockholm), Paris Saint-Germain (8 August, Gothenburg), Leeds United (12 August, Dublin) and AC Milan (15 August, Wrocław), before the Premier League campaign opens away to Hull City on 22 August.

news.headline: United thrash Rosenborg 5-0 in Michael Carrick's first win as permanent head coach
news.summary: Goals from Shea Lacey, Joshua Zirkzee, Jacob Devaney, Harry Amass and Ethan Williams sealed a 5-0 pre-season win in Trondheim on Friday, United's second friendly of the summer. Reports highlighted improved control and tempo, with 15-year-old JJ Gabriel included in the travelling squad.
